findings.title: Native multiplication bypasses the repository's decimal contract
findings.scenario: An order price or quantity contains a decimal value
findings.impact: Displayed or submitted totals can contain floating-point error
findings.suggestion: Use DecimalMath.times and add decimal-boundary tests

testSuggestions: Cover decimal boundaries such as 0.1 multiplied by 0.2
Regression-test the configured peer application's matching page
questions: Should the configured peer application receive the same calculation change?
